# ink-and-paper, vendored

A copy of `danfirsten/ink-and-paper` (tokens, CSS, the React primitives and motion helpers, the character drawings and DESIGN.md), taken on 17 Nov 2026 from its `main` at afc2748. It is vendored because the cloud sessions that build Fuego can't read other private repos, and because Fuego is going public. The smooth-scroll entry (`scroll.ts`, GSAP and Lenis) is left out: Fuego doesn't need it.

To refresh it, copy `css/`, `tokens/`, `characters/`, `src/` (without `scroll.ts`) and `DESIGN.md` from ink-and-paper over this folder, and note the date and commit here. Don't edit these files in place; change ink-and-paper and copy again.
